questions.question: The volume of a sphere is 36π cm³. What is the radius of the sphere?
questions.solution:
Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³

⇒ 36 π = (4/3)πr³

⇒ r³ = 27

⇒ r = 3

∴ The radius of the sphere is 3 cm

questions.question: What is the value of 2 – 2 ÷ 2 × 2 (2 of 2 – 2 – 2 ÷ 2)?
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order is given below:

Step-1: Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first and in the bracket,

Step-2: Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next.

Step-3: Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated.

Step-4: Last but not least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated.

⇒ 2 – 2 ÷ 2 × 2 (2 of 2 – 2 – 2 ÷ 2)

⇒ 2 – (2 ÷ 2) × 2 [(2 of 2) – 2 – (2 ÷ 2)]

⇒ 2 – 1 × 2 (4 – 2 – 1)

⇒ 2 – 1 × 2 × 1

⇒ 2 – 2

⇒ 0

questions.question: A 600 metre long train can cross a 1200 metre long platform in 36 seconds. In how much time (in seconds) can it cross a bridge 2200 metres long?
questions.solution:
{{Speed of the train }} = {{ }}frac{{Total distance}}{{Time }} = frac{{Total length}}{{Time }}

Rightarrow {{Speed of the train}} = {{}}frac{{600 + 1200}}{{36}} = 50 m/sec

Now, time taken by train to cross 2200m long bridge = {{}}frac{{600 + 2200}}{{50}} = 56 seconds 

∴ In 56 seconds can train cross the bridge 2200 metres long.

questions.question: The difference between the selling prices of an article is Rs. 1440, when it is sold at 20% profit and 17.5% loss. What will be the selling price when it is sold at 15% profit?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of an article be 100x

⇒ Selling price at 20% profit = 100x × 120% = 120x

⇒ Selling price at 17.5% loss = 100x × 82.5% = 82.5x

⇒ Difference = 120x – 82.5x

⇒ 1440 = 37.5x

⇒ x = 38.4

Hence, cost price of article = 100x = Rs. 3840

Now, selling price at 15% profit = 3840 × 115% = Rs. 4416

∴ The selling price when it is sold at 15% profit will be Rs. 4416.

questions.question: A can do a piece of work alone in 10 days, whereas B alone can do it in 15 days. They work together and get Rs. 2000 for their work. What is the share of B?
questions.solution:
A = 10 days, B = 15 days

⇒ A : B = 10 : 15 = 2 : 3

We know, efficiency ∝ 1/Time

⇒ A : B = 3 : 2

⇒ Share of B = [2/ (2 + 3)] × 2000 = 2 × 400 = 800

∴ The share of B is Rs. 800

questions.question:
What is difference between mean and median of the given data?

4, 6, 3, 7, 10, 13, 16 and 5?
questions.solution:
Mean = Sum of numbers/number of term

⇒ Mean = (4 + 6 + 3 + 7 + 10 + 13 + 16 + 5) /8

⇒ Mean = 64/8 = 8

⇒ Ascending order = 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10, 13, 16

⇒ Median = (6 + 7) /2 = 6.5

⇒ Difference between mean and median = 8 – 6.5 = 1.5

∴ Difference between mean and median will be 1.5.

questions.question: A sum becomes Rs. 500 in 5 years and Rs. 600 in 7 years at a certain rate percent per annum at simple interest. What is the sum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A sum becomes Rs. 500 in 5 years

A sum becomes Rs. 600 in 7 years

**Concept used:**

SI = PRT/100

P → princiapl r → rate of interest

**Calculation:**

Interest in 2 years = Amount after 7 years - amount after 5 years = 600 – 500 

Interest in 2 years = 100

⇒ Interest in 5 years = 100/2 × 5 = Rs. 250

Amount = Principal + interest

⇒ 500 = Principal + 250

⇒ Principal = 250

**∴ The sum is Rs. 250**

questions.question: What is the compound interest on Rs. 5000 in 2 years at the rate of 20% per annum? (interest compounded half yearly)
questions.solution:
Time = 2 years, rate = 20%

⇒ Time = 4 years, rate = 10% (because interest compounded half yearly)

⇒ C.I. = P(1 + r/100)t – P

⇒ C.I. = 5000[(11/10)⁴ – 1]

⇒ C.I. = 5000 × (4641/10000) = 4641/2 = Rs. 2320.5

∴ The compound interest is Rs. 2320.5

questions.question: Marked price of an article is Rs. 1500. If 16(2)/(3)\% discount is given, then what is the selling price?
questions.solution:
Selling price = marked price × (100 – discount)%

⇒ Selling price = 1500 × (100 – 50/3)%

⇒ Selling price = 1500 × (250/3)%

⇒ Selling price = Rs. 1250

∴ The selling price of an article is Rs. 1250

questions.question: Cost price of an article is Rs. 1440 and its selling price is Rs. 1800. What is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Cost price of an article = Rs. 1440

⇒ Selling price = Rs. 1800

⇒ Profit = selling price – cost price

⇒ Profit = 1800 – 1440 = Rs. 360

Now, profit % = [Profit/cost price] × 100

⇒ Profit % = [360/1440] × 100 = 25%

∴ The profit % of an article is 25%.

questions.question: What is the greatest number which can exactly divide 192, 1056 and 1584?
questions.solution:
Factors of 192, 1056 and 1584

⇒ 192 = 2⁶ × 3

⇒ 1056 = 2⁵ × 3 × 11

⇒ 1584 = 2⁴ × 3² × 11

⇒ Highest Common factors = 2⁴ × 3 = 48

∴ The greatest number is 48.

questions.question: Average age of 12 students is 14 years. If the age of teacher is also included, the average becomes 15 years. What is the age of the teacher?
questions.solution:
Average = Total age of all persons/number of person

⇒ Average age of 12 students = 14 years

⇒ Total age of 12 students = 14 × 12 = 168 years ...1)

Now, average age of 12 students and a teacher = 15 years

⇒ Total age of 12 students and a teacher = 15 × (12 + 1) = 195 years ...2)

From (2) – (1)

⇒ Age of a teacher = 195 – 168 = 27 years

∴ The age of the teacher is 27 years.

questions.solution:

The ratio of two numbers is 2 : 1. If each number is increased by 5, then the new ratio becomes 3 : 2

**Calculation:**

Let the first number be 2x

⇒ Second number = x

According to question,

Rightarrow {{}}frac{{2x + 5}}{{x + 5}} = (3)/(2)

⇒ 4x + 10 = 3x + 15

⇒ x = 5

⇒ The sum of the numbers = 2x + x = 3x = 15

**∴ The sum of the numbers is 15.**

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 10 hours. Pipe B can fill the same tank in 12 hours. Pipe C can empty the full tank in 16 hours. All the pipes are opened at 8:00 A.M. and Pipe A and B are closed at 10:00 A.M. After how much time from starting will the tank be empty?
questions.solution:
Let capacity of tank = LCM of (10, 12 and 16) = 240 units

Hence, efficiency of A = 240/10 = 24

Efficiency of B = 240/12 = 20

Efficiency of C = 240/ (-16) = -15 (Outlet pipe)

⇒ All the pipe are opened at 08: 00 am to 10 : 00 am = (24 + 20 – 15) × 2

⇒ All the pipe are opened at 08: 00 am to 10 : 00 am = 29 × 2 = 58

⇒ 58 units will be empty by pipe C = 58/15 hours = 3 hours 52 minutes

⇒ Total time = 2 hours + 3 hours 52 minutes = 5 hours 52 minutes

∴ Total time from starting will the tank be empty in 5 hours 52 minutes.

What is the difference between the average milk sold per day by Milkman 1 and the average milk sold by Milkman 2 per day?
questions.solution:

Total milk sold per day by Milkman 1 = 28 + 34 + 38 + 37 + 53 + 58 + 63 + 67 = 378 litres

Now, required difference = 48.25 – 47.25 = 1 litre

∴ The difference between the average milk sold per day by Milkman 1 and the average milk sold by Milkman 2 per day is 1 litre.

questions.question: Speed of a man is 45 km/h. In how much time (in seconds) will he cover a distance of 225 metres?
questions.solution:
Speed of a man = 45 km/h = 45 × 5/18 = 25/2 = 12.5 m/sec

Distance = 225 meters

⇒ Time = Distance/Speed

⇒ Time = 225/12.5 = 18 seconds

∴ The man can cover a distance of 225 metres in 18 seconds.

questions.question:
What are respectively the curved surface area and volume of a hemisphere of radius 21 cm?

(Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the hemisphere = 21 cm.

**Formula Used:**

⇒ C.S.A of the hemisphere = 2πr². 

⇒ Volume of the hemisphere = (2/3) × πr³

**Calculation:**

⇒ C.S.A of the hemisphere = 2 × (22/7) × (21)² = 2772 cm².

⇒ Volume of the hemisphere = (2/3) × (22/7) × (21)³ = 19404 cm³

**∴ volume = 19404 cm³ and C.S.A = 2772 cm².**

questions.question: Average of 10 numbers is 14.8. If two numbers 5 and 23 are replaced by 13 and 26 respectively, then what is the new average?
questions.solution:
Average = sum of numbers/number of term

Average of 10 numbers = 14.8

Hence, sum of 10 numbers = 14.8 × 10 = 148

⇒ 5 + 23 = 28

⇒ 13 + 26 = 39

⇒ Difference = 39 – 28 = 11

⇒ Sum of 10 numbers after replacement = 148 + 11 = 159

Hence, new average of 10 numbers = 15.9

∴ The new average of 10 numbers is 15.9
